title: Weapons e2e (laser flash in the browser + screenshot) + TASK-43 close-out
description: The final piece of TASK-43: a Playwright e2e (app/tests/e2e/weapons.spec.ts) that claims in the browser, slows the FX, fires a laser with LMB and proves the flash was event-driven from the server (window.__FX__.laserFlashes >= 1 — the hook only counts server combat_event frames, so it already proves server authority, never local intent), screenshots it; then the full verification pass (npm run test, tsc, lint over the never-linted TASK-43 files) and the TASK-43 bookkeeping (step flags, LOG entry, STRUCTURE check, handoff deletion) with the final commit. Same shape as the proven TASK-40.1 + TASK-40.2 close-out pair, combined; the e2e is the only substantive new work.

steps.description: Verify the prior tasks' state (finish TASK-43.2 first if it ran out of time)
steps.details: git status + git log --oneline f35a5df..HEAD: expect the TASK-43.1 commit (ridge-LOS test green, 33/33) and the TASK-43.2 commit (shard.weapons.ws.test.ts). Re-run the weapons tests once: cd app && npx vitest run src/shared/weapons.test.ts src/server/shard/shard.weapons.test.ts src/server/shard/shard.weapons.ws.test.ts — all green before touching the e2e. If TASK-43.2 ran out of time mid-scenario, its handoff/working tree describes the remainder — finish the ws test exactly per the TASK-43.2 spec, commit it as its own WIP commit, then continue. No bookkeeping until the e2e is green.

Model on app/tests/e2e/multiplayer.spec.ts (claim flow + the e2eServer fixture) with the constants style of cargo.spec.ts: `import { expect, test } from './fixtures'`, collectErrors/uniqueCallsign from './helpers', ClaimPage from './pages/claim', GamePage from './pages/game', `const PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1` mirrored (Playwright does NOT resolve tsconfig path aliases — never import app/src modules), test.setTimeout(150_000). The fixture boots the real dev server itself (random port, tmp sqlite, NODE_ENV=development — so the DEV-only window.__FX__ hook and the dev routes exist); run `cd app && npm run test:e2e weapons.spec.ts` and do NOT also run npm run dev. ONE test: (1) claim a callsign in the browser (multiplayer.spec.ts pattern; the player spawns INSIDE the docked scout — #ship-hud-cargo visible). (2) page.evaluate(() => { document.documentElement.dataset.fxSlow = '1' }) — the stretched-lifetime switch combat-fx.ts reads (line ~69: `document.documentElement.dataset.fxSlow === '1'` — it is documentElement, NOT document.body). (3) wait for #weapon-hud visible (appears once the self ship entity lands; assert it shows the 'laser' loadout and the energy bar — the AC-3 HUD stub). (4) page.mouse.click at the CENTER of #game-canvas (mousedown on the canvas sends the 'fire' frame — main.tsx; the scout's active weapon is the laser, no 1/2 key needed; the ship is docked — the server has NO docked gate on fire, a laser raycast is accepted from the pad with full materialized energy 100). (5) poll `window.__FX__` until laserFlashes >= 1 (expect.poll or waitForFunction, 5 s timeout) — recordCombatEvent (fx-debug.ts) is only called for server combat_event frames, so this ALONE proves the server accepted the fire (a denied fire shows no FX — the spec's core contract); optionally add a second RawWsClient observer in the same system asserting it receives the 'laser-fired' combat_event (raw-ws.ts) to close the loop explicitly. (6) IMMEDIATELY page.screenshot({ path: '.ralph/screenshots/TASK-43-1.png' }) — under fxSlow the laser line flash is stretched to ~500 ms, so it is visible in the frame; if a verification pass finds no flash in the png (timing), click once more (the 333 ms cooldown allows re-fires) and re-shoot — re-shooting is cheap, do not over-engineer retries. (7) assertClean() console-clean per the collectErrors pattern. The screenshot file is UNTRACKED (only .ralph/screenshots/.gitkeep is committed) — do not git add the png.

cd app && npm run test:e2e weapons.spec.ts → green on a fresh run. Then the FULL unit suite: npm run test (~3.5 min; the first full run since 47d41bc — the rest of the suite was last fully green at the TASK-42 close-out: 125 files / 1077 passed / 1 skipped; the new weapons files add ~33 unit tests + the ws file). Known pre-existing flaky class (characterized in the TASK-40.2 close-out, load-sensitive on this machine, fail on the parent commit too): transition/streaming p99 benchmarks, the surface 5 s timeout, multiplayer-foot scale p95, persist perf guard — if any go red, re-run that file ALONE twice; if it passes in isolation, record it as a pre-existing flaky in the LOG entry (cite the isolated pass) and proceed; a NON-benchmark red must be fixed before bookkeeping. Then npx tsc --noEmit (clean). Then the lint pass — the TASK-43 files were NEVER through eslint/prettier (flagged in the handoff): npx eslint --fix + npx prettier --write on app/src/shared/weapons.ts, app/src/shared/weapons.test.ts, app/src/server/shard/shard.ts, app/src/server/shard/shard.weapons.test.ts, app/src/server/shard/types.ts, app/src/server/shards.ts, app/src/shared/protocol/schemas.ts, app/src/client/fx.ts, app/src/client/fx-debug.ts, app/src/client/ui/weapon-hud.tsx, app/src/client/world/combat-fx.ts, app/src/client/world/WorldManager.ts, app/src/client/main.tsx, plus every file TASK-43.1/43.2/43.3 touched; re-run the weapons test files if any source file changed.

(1) Step flags: if .ralph/tasks/TASK-43.json still exists, set all 4 step `pass` flags to true (after the split it may have been consumed — the per-task specs' flags then cover it; check what is actually on disk and make the parent's 4 steps true if present). (2) .ralph/tasks.json: "passes": true for TASK-43.3 (TASK-43.1/.2 were set by their own iterations per the standard flow — verify both are true). (3) New TOP entry in .ralph/logs/LOG.md in the TASK-42 style: '### YYYY-MM-DD — TASK-43: Weapons: lasers and missiles with per-class loadouts' + a summary paragraph (instant-hit laser 8 dmg/400 m/3 s/2 energy; homing missiles 25 dmg/5 m splash 12/800 m/120 u-s/1.5 rad-s/0.5 s; loadouts scout [laser] / interceptor [laser, missile x4] / freighter [laser]; server re-derives everything, denied fires spend nothing, 30-fires/s → 5 s weapon lock; the two mid-task bug fixes — turnToward Rodrigues math and denied-missile energy refund — and the ridge-LOS regime finding) + Unit / WS / E2E / Verify bullets with the FRESH numbers (33 unit, ws scenario count, e2e run time, full-suite count, screenshot path .ralph/screenshots/TASK-43-1.png). (4) Bump 'Tasks Completed' in the LOG header (currently 56) by 1; leave 'Current Task' as '—'. (5) Check .ralph/STRUCTURE.md: the new files all live in EXISTING directories (app/src/client — fx.ts, fx-debug.ts; app/src/client/ui — weapon-hud.tsx; app/src/client/world — combat-fx.ts) — add/adjust lines only if the file's convention demands (mirror how TASK-42's combat.ts was noted). (6) DELETE .ralph/handoff/TASK-43.md. (7) Confirm no background processes (dev server etc.) are running. (8) Commit everything (Conventional Commit, e.g. 'feat(weapons): TASK-43 — instant lasers + homing missiles, e2e-verified, close-out'). (9) Output <promise>TASK-43:DONE</promise> and STOP.

acceptanceCriteria: app/tests/e2e/weapons.spec.ts exists, mirrors the multiplayer.spec.ts/cargo.spec.ts conventions (same imports, mirrored PROTOCOL_VERSION const, e2eServer fixture, 150 s timeout, console-clean assert) and passes on a fresh `cd app && npm run test:e2e weapons.spec.ts` run

The e2e proves the AC 'fire a laser in the browser, screenshot the flash': window.__FX__.laserFlashes >= 1 after the LMB click (server-event-driven — a denied fire cannot reach the hook) and .ralph/screenshots/TASK-43-1.png shows the stretched laser line flash (verify content, not just existence)
cd app && npm run test (full suite) green — or every red is a documented pre-existing flaky perf benchmark that passes in isolation (the TASK-40.2 precedent), with the evidence cited in the LOG entry
cd app && npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint + prettier clean across ALL TASK-43 files (the 47d41bc/2547175 files were never linted — they are covered by step 3)

Bookkeeping complete: TASK-43's 4 step flags true (if the parent spec still exists), TASK-43.3 passes:true in .ralph/tasks.json, new top LOG.md entry with fresh numbers + screenshot path, 'Tasks Completed' bumped, .ralph/handoff/TASK-43.md deleted, STRUCTURE.md checked

With TASK-43.1 (33/33 weapon unit tests incl. the ridge-LOS fix) and TASK-43.2 (ws integration: A fires at B, B's shields drop, C sees the events) committed, EVERY TASK-43 acceptance criterion is now met: laser + missile behavior, loadouts + HUD stub, server authority + anti-spam lock, event-driven FX, unit/WS/e2e tests, npm run test green
Everything committed with a Conventional Commit message; no background processes left; <promise>TASK-43:DONE</promise> emitted
notes: CLOSE-OUT + E2E — by the time this task starts the whole feature is committed: 47d41bc (implementation: shared weapons.ts, protocol schemas, shard fire pipeline + missile sim, client FX + HUD), 2547175 + f35a5df (unit tests + the turnToward/denied-refund bug fixes), TASK-43.1's commit (ridge-LOS test → 33/33), TASK-43.2's commit (shard.weapons.ws.test.ts). The only substantive new work is the e2e spec; the rest is ~25 min (e2e run ~30 s, full suite ~3.5 min, lint, flags).

E2E FACTS (verified against the committed code — do not re-derive): (a) the e2eServer fixture boots the real dev server itself (random ports, tmp sqlite, NODE_ENV=development) — run `npm run test:e2e weapons.spec.ts`, NEVER alongside npm run dev; (b) the FX slow-mo switch is `document.documentElement.dataset.fxSlow = '1'` (combat-fx.ts line ~69) — it stretches the 60 ms laser flash to ~500 ms for the screenshot; the handoff's 'document.body.dataset' wording was WRONG, the code reads documentElement; (c) window.__FX__ (fx-debug.ts, DEV-gated) — {events, laserFlashes, impacts}; recordCombatEvent is called by main.tsx ONLY for server combat_event frames, so laserFlashes >= 1 proves the SERVER accepted the fire (the spec's 'FX never from local intent' contract); (d) #weapon-hud (weapon-hud.tsx) renders as soon as the self ship's classId is known (docked included) — active weapon name + energy bar + LOW ENERGY / WEAPON LOCKED prompts; (e) mousedown on #game-canvas sends the 'fire' frame (main.tsx ~line 889-895); the scout's loadout is laser-only and the active weapon defaults to the laser — no 1/2 key needed; (f) the server has NO docked gate on handleFire — a docked scout on the pad can fire (full energy 100 after the first tick materializes it); (g) screenshots are untracked (only .ralph/screenshots/.gitkeep is committed) — write the png, verify it, do not git add it; (h) the Playwright runner does NOT resolve tsconfig aliases — mirror constants (PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1, as cargo.spec.ts does).

FULL-SUITE FACTS: ~3.5 min; last fully green at the TASK-42 close-out (125 files / 1077 passed / 1 skipped) — since then only weapons files were added/changed, and turnToward is shared but only exercised by the weapons tests (the 33 unit tests are green from TASK-43.1). Pre-existing load-sensitive flaky class (fail on the parent commit too, pass in isolation): transition/streaming p99 benchmarks, surface 5 s timeout, multiplayer-foot scale p95, persist perf guard.

NEVER-LINTED FILE LIST (the handoff flagged it; step 3 covers it): app/src/shared/weapons.ts, app/src/shared/weapons.test.ts, app/src/server/shard/shard.ts, app/src/server/shard/shard.weapons.test.ts, app/src/server/shard/types.ts, app/src/server/shards.ts, app/src/shared/protocol/schemas.ts, app/src/client/fx.ts, app/src/client/fx-debug.ts, app/src/client/ui/weapon-hud.tsx, app/src/client/world/combat-fx.ts, app/src/client/world/WorldManager.ts, app/src/client/main.tsx.

BOOKKEEPING SHAPES: LOG.md entries are '### YYYY-MM-DD — TASK-NN: <title>' + summary + Unit/WS/E2E/Verify bullets — mirror the TASK-42 entry (the current top entry); the LOG header carries 'Tasks Completed' (currently 56) and 'Current Task' ('—'); the TASK-43 spec's 4 steps all start pass: false in .ralph/tasks/TASK-43.json; the close-out emits the PARENT promise <promise>TASK-43:DONE</promise> (the TASK-40.2 precedent: <promise>TASK-40:DONE</promise>); Conventional Commits throughout.
DO NOT SCOPE-CREEP: the full HUD (TASK-50), surface combat (TASK-48) and target lock (TASK-44) are separate tasks — the weapon HUD is the intentional stub and the e2e asserts only what it renders.
